links.rationale: C024 loses integral correlation; C037 exactly refutes arbitrary extension monotonicity and loses one of three parent support relevance coordinates. C041 must preserve both warnings without conflating them.

Both are valid local routes whose proposed root use overreaches their mathematical scope: C024 loses integrality correlation, while the discarded explicitness contract collapses the direct predicate into P/poly.
